I saved Hollis Mbeki's note that Gate 40 is now his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups, as a fact about him in the memory system. I replied in his DM to confirm. The memory system flagged the note as a standing instruction, so it is stored but won't be used until the brain owner confirms it with `gbrain trust confirm f1`. I told Hollis that.

The save came back marked `visibility: "world"`. I can't tell whether that means only the type of fact or that every brain reader can see it. Normally facts saved by members stay private, and I didn't ask to share it. Before confirming, the owner should check that it's only visible to Hollis. Nothing I found in the brain contradicts the new gate.
